title: Route 11, Diglett's Cave, Routes 9–10
subtitle: Itemfinder, Flash, the Old Amber, road to Rock Tunnel

steps.text: Route 11 (east of Vermilion): a gauntlet of trainers. Drowzee and Sandshrew live here. The route is blocked by a sleeping Snorlax on Route 12 until you have the Poké Flute.
Route 11 gate, upstairs: Oak's aide gives the Itemfinder once you have caught 30 species. Use it to detect hidden items.
Same gate upstairs: trade a Nidorina for Nidorino (or the reverse).
Diglett's Cave (entrance north of Route 11): straight tunnel to Route 2. Catch a Diglett or Dugtrio; they wreck Lt. Surge and later Electric/Poison foes.
Route 2 east gate: Oak's aide gives HM05 Flash (10 species caught). You need it for Rock Tunnel.
Route 2 house (cut the tree): trade an Abra for Mimien the Mr. Mime.
Pewter Museum: use Cut on the tree beside the building to reach the back door. The scientist gives the Old Amber (revive as Aerodactyl on Cinnabar).
Back to Cerulean, cut the tree east of the city and take Route 9. Mostly trainers; Rattata, Spearow, Ekans.
Route 10 north: Pokémon Center outside Rock Tunnel. Voltorb, Magnemite, Machop in the grass.
Route 10 Pokémon Center: Oak's aide gives an Everstone once you have caught 20 species.
